name: myStartupTool

sources.title: Homepage — directory-submission service: free account unlocks a 183-directory list plus one free submission by them; paid done-for-you packages

conditions: Free registration gives access to the curated 183-directory list (free+paid directories, 'updated monthly') plus a single free submission done by their team; the actual multi-directory submission service is paid
requirements: This is a submission SERVICE, not a destination directory — it does not list your product on mystartuptool.com; it submits to other directories for you
Covers SaaS, mobile app, and beta startups per their copy
Claims manual submission ('We are NOT using automated tools')
preparation: Standard submission kit: product name, URL, descriptions (short + long), logo, screenshots, category, founder details — reusable across all 183 directories
For paid: a package selection on /pricing
workflow: Either use their directory list to submit yourself, or claim the single free submission they perform for you
For the paid route: pick a package on /pricing and they submit manually on your behalf
watchFor: Not a launch destination itself — the outcome is listings on OTHER directories, which you could also do directly
Directory lists of this type contain many dead/spammy targets — verify each destination before paying for bulk submission
© 2024 footer and Cyprus address; low-key service, blog is a .php page — modest upkeep signal
A 'free submission' is a lead-in for the paid packages
countsAsLive: For this service, 'live' means the third-party directory listings they submit on your behalf are published — verify each one individually; there is no mystartuptool.com listing to check
unknowns: Paid package prices — pricing page not fetched
Which of the 183 directories are currently live and worthwhile
Quality/placement guarantee for the free submission
